Tornado Cash Classic proof components

The bundled prover is built locally from the exact dependencies in package-lock.json.
It is based on Tornado Cash Classic UI's MIT-licensed integration and GPL-licensed
snarkjs/websnark proof implementations. Original license texts accompany this file.

Tornado Classic UI / circuit assets:
https://github.com/tornadocash/tornado-classic-ui/tree/a83fae0772c8da084c0e76b3a756b456f5b9f5bb

websnark (GPL-3.0-or-later):
https://github.com/tornadocash/websnark/tree/4c0af6a8b65aabea3c09f377f63c44e7a58afa6d

snarkjs (GPL-3.0-or-later):
https://github.com/tornadocash/snarkjs/tree/869181cfaf7526fe8972073d31655493a04326d5

MV3 compatibility changes in scripts/build-tornado.mjs:
- Legacy witness templates/functions are compiled into static JavaScript at build time.
- Browser proof workers are shipped as a separate local JavaScript file.
- Browser proof worker concurrency is limited to two to bound memory consumption.

No runtime JavaScript is fetched from Tornado Cash, relayers, RPC providers, or CDNs.
Circuit JSON and the proving key are packaged data, not executable downloads.
Archive identities and the SHA-256 of unpacked assets are recorded in provenance.json.
Rebuild with npm ci --ignore-scripts followed by npm run build.
